tagline: International Association for the Representation of Inland Waterway Interests
hero_kpi_rationale: Sector organization without financial data: focus on membership engagement and international representation activities

kpis.name: Congress Attendance
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the annual IVR Congress representing member countries.
kpis.description: The 2024 Annual Congress (May 15-17 in Frankfurt) welcomed 225 participants from 11 European countries. This event is the organization's flagship annual milestone featuring workshops, committee meetings, and general assembly.
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement at flagship event

kpis.name: Member Countries
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in the organization's membership.
kpis.description: The association represents the interests of the European inland waterway sector through members from 11 distinct countries, demonstrating its geographic scope and international influence.
kpis.signal: Pan-European representation in inland waterway sector

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Participants
kpis.explanation: First-ever dedicated event for technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in inland navigation.
kpis.description: The inaugural Loss Prevention Symposium was held on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp, bringing together 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany. This inaugural event covers technical and financial aspects of loss prevention.
kpis.signal: Inaugural specialized event with strong regional attendance

kpis.name: Technical Publications
kpis.explanation: Number of technical guideline documents issued to support industry standards and practices.
kpis.description: Several new technical fact sheets were published in 2024 by the association's committees to provide current and relevant information to the inland waterway industry.

kpis.name: CESNI Participation
kpis.explanation: Representation at European Committee for standardization in inland navigation technical matters.
kpis.description: The organization participated as an observer at CESNI European Committee meetings (April 11 and October 17, 2024) to contribute to the development of standardization norms in inland navigation.
kpis.signal: Active role in European regulatory standards development

kpis.name: Board Meetings
kpis.explanation: Number of dedicated meeting sessions held by loss prevention committee during the reporting year.
kpis.description: The Loss Prevention Committee convened three times in 2024 with in-person member attendance to oversee and direct sector initiatives.
kpis.signal: Regular governance and oversight of loss prevention initiatives

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.1 bn EUR in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.0 bn EUR in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or digital transformation initiatives in the 2024 annual report.
evidence: Focus is on regulatory representation, technical standards, and knowledge dissemination
Digitalization mentioned only in context of professional qualification standards (CESNI scope)
No reference to AI-powered tools, automated analytics, or intelligent systems
